notes.title: Patch v11.20
notes.notes:

- Campaign Reconnexus game mode: When playing on Argon Difficulty for the first time there's now an intro text (to better explain the game mode's mechanics).
- Campaign Reconnexus game mode: The Core Dealer icon now has a bit of colour (so it's easy to see if a Core is available).

notes.title: Patch v11.19
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- The smallest font has had some tweaks (so is easier to read).
- Settings - Fullscaling: Its resolution can now go up to x14 (from x7).
- Menus: The borders on currently selected icons have been brightened (so it's more obvious when not using mouse input).
- Choose Game Mode menu: The Survival Function and Campaign Reconnexus game modes have swapped places (so the unlock process has less of a Difficulty spike).
- Rogue Convergence: A Class Heritage shop will now also show just before the Boss (to create a bit more difference between classes).

- Campaign Reconnexus: A Class Heritage shop will now also show in the end Element shops (to create a bit more difference between classes).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 1 - Boss: The amount of attacks he fires has been tuned down slightly, especially when he has more than 50% Health (so less of a Difficulty spike). 
- Compendium - Bestiary: The Systemous Masterorium bosses now have bigger example sprites (so look cooler than the regular Custodian boss).
- Star Devourer weapon: Their projectile will no longer do damage until it's fully grown (otherwise it can look like it doesn't spawn at all if it spawns on a powerful enemy).
- Eggcellent Eggy class: He will no longer randomise your Voids Vigil weapon (since would be pointless buying them).
- Player Drones: Their default blue colours have been tweaked (so they look less like you for better visibility).
- Guardum Drone: Their blue shield bubble colour has been tweaked (so they look less like regular interact bubbles for better visibility).
- Voidmare Skullion enemy: When destroyed they now spawn 1-3 regular Skullions.

//bug fixes
- Choose Difficulty menu: The hover sprite was incorrect if you haven't yet beaten that Difficulty.
- Lure Mineus: If the current theme is Emeralt then they would also spawn a background sprite (which would look messy in long Survival runs).
- Lazumi Missileer enemy: There was a chance its laser attack could remain even after it was destroyed.

notes.title: Voids Vigil Full Release
notes.notes:
Welcome back Voidseekers new and old.. the Void gapes to reveal its true splendour to you. Voids Vigil is now fully released and fully playable. The game has also had a stonking update (v11), with the changes listed below, so even olden seekers will see new sights to witness.

Enjoy!  :]


The Campaign Reconnexus game mode has now been fully implemented. It includes all 7 Difficulties, Nightmare Mode, Campaign Survival, and now makes an appearance in Voidworld Trials too.

There's 3 new classes, the Dark Metaman, Pussy Purrer, and Salvage Stripper.

A new ultimate weapon called the Voids Vigil that has the power to erase enemies from time and space, and even bosses when its trait is upgraded.

7 new drone related Hats have been added and 2 new skin Colours (Pristine Sheen, Cursed Gloss). You can also now choose a Randomise option for the your Hat and/or Skin which randomises it each time you start a new run.

Some other Campaign Reconnexus game mode stuff...
- Map: Icons can now often not be connected to all its surrounding icons (to create more separate routes across the map).
- Map: A new special Sector has been added called Dormant Arena which uses the Survival Function level generation and has +50% enemy spawns.
- Map: A new Stranger event has been added called Core Seller who sells a Power Core for a nice price.
- Map: A new Stranger event has been added called X Marks The Spot who can reveal a hidden Treasure Hideaway Sector.
- Map: Various tweaks to the map generation.
- Map: The intro text has been replaced with a bottom text line, which is also used to show when you're low on Cores.
- Hats/Drones/Class unlock rooms can now also show in this game mode.
- End Boss - Difficulty 1: It now has 6 less Mini Eyes to poke out.
- End Boss - Difficulty 3: He will attack you with his Massive Balls less frequently now.

Some Clashful Cards game mode stuff...
- A 2 Player Mode has been added so 2 local players can give each other a jolly good bashing.
- When choosing where to deploy a Card it now shows which table spots it can attack.
- 9 new Cards have been added for the Blobbernought, Observum, and Ethereal Shade enemies.
- End Screen: Going to the Title Screen will now also open the Choose Game Mode menu.

Some Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- Nightmare Mode: During the Boss fight the usual Skullions will now also spawn.
- Nightmare Mode: Once the Swarm is triggered the spawn rate for Skullions is doubled.
- End Boss: The room will no longer spawn starting mines in regular mode, but will now always spawn them in Nightmare Mode.
- End Boss - Difficulty 2: It now has an extra Wall Laser and both Wall Lasers can now fire from the start (instead of only triggering when the boss is at 50% Health).
- Bosses now have a 20% reduction to Damage they suffer (so high Damage weapons do less).

Some Survival Function game mode stuff...

Other new stuff...
- 64 new achievements!
- Mega Booty Haulers have been added which give an extra +69% bonus when hacked over the normal version.
- 3 new special sectors have been added: Dataorious Directory, Hauliage Hub, Cog Producer.
- Mega enemies now also drop Huge Cogs.
- 4 new Encrypted Stranger events: Exotical Nanisseur, Dronerous Rigger, Vessel Mnemonic, Regenerative Environeer.
- 4 new Abilities: Swollen Balls, Chronos Snap, Mecha Gang, Hex Shard.
- 5 new Passive Items: Lucky Paw, Dash Reverseum, Blade Whirler, Haul Megatonia, Midas Fingerer.

Some Class Vessel changes...
- Errant Knight class: He now has a huge Barricade Shield (instead of 2 normal sized Shields).
- Tofu Chaser class: In the first sector the No Hit Score bonus is now 1111 (instead of 2222 so less need to restart if you don't get it).

- Malware Corrupted: The Max Health bonus for killing Hexxed enemies now also boosts your Max Energy too.

Some Shop related changes...
- Elamentalist shop: They now have less chance to offer an Element Chamber unless the Element stat is at least 5+.
- Device Repository shop: It now has a high chance to offer multiple unlocked items (in case you haven't unlocked many items).
- Master Baiter shop: It now has a high chance to offer multiple unlocked items (in case you haven't unlocked many items).
- Encrypted Stranger shop: The Cog cost for many of its event options has been reduced.

Other miscellaneous changes...
- Nightmare Mode: Every 4 seconds there's now a flat 33% chance of spawning an extra Skullion (otherwise they were quite uncommon in earlier Difficulties).
- The cost of all Lure Enemy type abilities has been halved.
- Humongous Cogs ability: It can now transform Big Cog pickups into Huge Cogs.
- Missile Salvo ability: Its Damage is now increased based on the current Sector number.
- Freeze Shard ability: Its cost has been reduced to 10 (from 20).
- Lure Enemy abilties: The amount of kills needed to unlock the early enemy lures has decreased.
- Cog Enlarger passive item: It can now transform Big Cog pickups into Huge Cogs.
- Cog Sniffer Servomegatron Drone: It can now transform Big Cog pickups into Huge Cogs.
- Scrap Lobber weapon: Its projectiles life span has boosted by +66%.
- Miasmal Wobble weapon: Its projectiles life span has boosted by +33%.
- Trojan Doll passive item: The bonus damage now affects enemies suffering from any status effect (so not just Hex/Curse).
- Runner Tuner passive item: This now instead boosts the Damage/Precision of weapons sold at the Gun Runner shop by +50% (previously it just gave them Affinity upgrades).
- Spook/Blobify Traits: These will no longer trigger if the enemy doesn't drop any Cogs (eg Blobby).
- Frost Trait: This will no longer affect Elite/Mega enemies (since most have weird movement patterns).
- Knockback Trait: This will no longer affect Elite/Mega enemies (since most have weird movement patterns).
- Blossum enemy: They no longer spawn bullets when they die (to reduce bullet spam).
- Blobbernought enemy: Their Health has been slightly reduced.
- Mega Mineire enemy: Their Health has been reduced.
- Mega Snekouss enemy: Their Health has been reduced.
- Sector Systematiser enemy: Their Health have been reduced.
- Drone Depot room: They can now show up more than once (previously they were only used for the Drone unlocks so were capped to 1 per run).
- Defence Grid special room: It no longer increases how long Lasers will be active for.

And bug fixes...
- Settings: When using the CRT effect with the Steam Deck resolution the pixel scaling looked scuffed.
- Settings - Save Data: When deleting all progression it was also closing the game.
- Status Screen: When using a gamepad and viewing sub-menus in the Config screen pressing the Back button would also swap the category.

- Survival Function game mode: When taking Trove items some world objects weren't being instantly updated (eg Shield Traitum).

- Scav Junker shop: If the Store Restockments passive item was triggered then the item type wasn't being updated.
- Schematic Engraver shop: When offering an Astro Starstorm mega trait the icon was scuffed.

- The unlocking of Drone items is no longer tied to the Rogue Convergence Difficulty level (so can now all be unlocked from any Difficulty).

//bug fixes...
- Survival Function game mode: When choosing a Difficulty the Fortuity Destiny text and icon may wrongly show as locked.
- Survival Function game mode: Opening a weapon Treasure Trove could cause a crash.
- Junk Booter class: Taking the Auxiliary Abilitum item then triggering the extra ability could cause a crash.
- Junk Booter class: When using a mouse the item selector below some shop items wasn't accurate.
- Ethereal Eternal class: In the Status Screen and mini-bars the Health/Energy were showing differently.
- Servomegatronica Gunineer drone: He could cause a crash if the only weapons you had were Manifold Wands.
- Sector Systematiser enemy: He could slow the spawning of enemy waves in earlier Difficulties.

notes.title: Patch v3.1
notes.notes:
//misc changes...
- Servomegatronica Impostus: He'll now spawn the mega enemy 12-16 seconds into the level (instead of 3-5 seconds).

//bug fixes...
- Compendium - Itemography: When using a mouse some of the menu selector wasn't accurate.
- Moving diagonally into a wall could then prevent you from sliding along that wall.
- Errant Knight class: Buying a Servomegatronica Gunineer drone would cause a hard freeze when entering the next level.
- Errant Knight class: Gunineer drones weren't randomising their gun elements correctly.
- Ethereal Eternal class: The Shade enemies were spawning during a Boss fight.
- Blossum enemy: They were showing above regular enemies.
- Encrypted Stranger - Systematiser Sector: This event could be offered just before a Boss fight.

notes.title: Patch v2.6
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- Gamepad: The analogue stick deadzone is now set to a higher amount if you're currently in a menu.
- Weaponsmith Anvil item: Its cost has increased to 75.

//bug fixes
- Voidworld Challenges: The check to see if you have unlocked the correct Starting Weapon wasn't consistent.
- Buying a hell of a lot of passive items could cause a crash.
- Settings - Visibility - Enemy Outlines: The explosive Mineire enemies in the green theme would show the wrong outline.
- Settings - Visibility - Attack Outlines: When using certain colours some attacks would become bright white.
- Some enemy attacks were using the Enemy Outline colour instead of the Attack Outline colour.
- Gun Runner Shop:  Viewing a weapon's Traits could cause a crash.
- Gun Runner Shop: When using a gamepad pressing Right when on a shop item would move the selector to the Destruction stat instead of Traits.
- Manifold Wand weapon: Increasing its Level wasn't boosting its stats.
- Element Deposit sector room: Its base sprite could show the wrong colour gems.

notes.title: Patch v2.5
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Achievement - Starting Weaponry Fulfillment: This could trigger without unlocking all the starting weapons.
- Achievement - Elementless Forsaken Survived: The class name wasn't quite correct.
- Settings - Enemy Outlines: When set to On some enemies could cause a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad pressing Right to move to a weapon's stats could cause a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: Switching the input from gamepad to mouse could cause a crash.
- Cog Sniffer drone: He could cause a crash when spawning a Cog.
- Tutorial: When using the Steam Deck / CRT resolution some elements weren't showing correctly.
- When using the Steam Deck / CRT resolution some class specific menus weren't showing correctly.

notes.title: Patch v2.3
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Settings - Mouse Controls: The Mouse Support option wasn't showing a Menu Confirm button tip.
- Starting a Survival Function run without first playing a Rogue Convergence could cause a crash.
- Droneraiser Minioneer class: When creating new shops it could cause a hard freeze if you had a lot of high level Drones.
- Errant Knight class: You wouldn't be offered a Moonlit Greatsword if you already had one.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: Taking the Elementalist Randomiser item could cause a crash.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: He could be offered the Wretched Chassis class item.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: In a Survival Function the Mimic Menu wouldn't allow you to open the Status Screen and opening the Escape Menu was scuffed.
- Dodgy Networker class: In a Survival Function the Stranger Menu wouldn't allow you to open the Status Screen and opening the Escape Menu was scuffed.
- Banished Prisoner class: In a Survival Function it was easy to accidentally Seal/Banish an item when the Trove first opens.
- Gun Runner shop: He could offer a weapon that was using the wrong Element.
- Gun Runner shop: The Manifold Wand was showing the wrong Damage/Precision stat.
- Device Repository shop: It was possible for an item to show as locked despite you having it in your Codex.

notes.title: Patch v2.2
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Choose Difficulty menu: The Best Score stat could show as a decimal.
- Escape Menu: If you restart/quit then background music could still play if multiple menus were nested open.
- Rogue Convergence: The End Boss could show the Flee status effect.
- Gunslinger Desperado class: They could be offered an item that increases their gun slots which could cause a crash.
- Abilitary Connoisseur class: They could be offered an item that increases their ability slots which could cause a crash.
- Droneraiser Minioneer class: They could be offered an item that increases their drone slots which could cause a crash.
- Dodgy Networker class: Selecting his Contract Dealer item in the Status Screen would cause a crash.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: Some shop related class items when taken weren't taking effect until the next sector.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: He could be offered multiple class items that increase your max guns/abilities/drones.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: He could be offered the Unupgradable Weapons class item.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: If you had a Guilded Rolls item and used it to reroll then it would reduce your Max Health by -2.
- Errant Knight class: He could be offered non-melee Mega Weapons.
- Errant Knight class: Offered Mega Weapons were using their default Element colour.
- Errant Knight class: His Shields could appear behind some objects (eg Boss).
- Droneous Eggling ability: If it spawned an upgraded Guard Drone then it would cause a crash.
- Elemental Fluid item: During a Rogue Convergence the extra stat boost was still being applied until you bought an item.
- Primitive Traitum item: When bought the cost reduction wasn't taking effect until the next sector.
- Elementalist Shop: You could be offered an Element Core which Difficulty does not contain that element.
- Shops: When using a gamepad if you entered a shop which was sold out then it would cause a crash.
- Encrypted Stranger: Backing out then re-entering the Stranger would give a different event.
- Encrypted Stranger - Ethereal Extortion: This could still spawn Shades after the sector exit portal had opened.

notes.title: Patch v2.1
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: Choosing the Shieldy Obsession item would cause a hard freeze.

notes.title: Patch v1.9
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- Increased your basic movement speed by +5%.
- Element Bearer classes: If you're playing a Difficulty that doesn't include your default Element Core then you can now be offered an appropriate Core.
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 3 Boss: Reduced the size of the collision mask on the largest balls. Increased its attack cool down.
- Emeralt Sectors: Cog pickups are now coloured more blue (so they blend in less with enemies).
- Element Core items: Clarified in its description that the stat boost will change if the element stat later changes.
- Mega Potion item: This now also gives 3 seconds of Invincibility when used.
- Manufactorium special room: The amount of enemies it spawns has been increased.
- Mega Sneki enemy: It now turns around when offscreen faster.
- Void Devourer weapon: Their homing behaviour now works more like a regular homing projectile (so they don't hang around the middle of the screen).
- Bubble Brewer weapon: Reduced the brightness of its projectiles.
- Cog Hammer weapon: Increased its Damage.

//bug fixes
- It was possible to get multiple Hat unlocks in a single run.
- Bigly Auraments item: It wasn't boosting some auras.
- Five Finger Function item: You could steal some items you wouldn't be able to buy.

notes.title: Patch v1.8
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- Improved base performance during sectors.
- Online Leaderboard: When opening a leaderboard if the filter was set to You but you don't have a score to show then it will now temporarily switch to showing the Elite scores.
- The Mouse Lock Cursor setting is now set to Off by default.
- Rogue Convergence: Clashful Card pickups now won't fly away when the exit portal opens.
- Corrosion status: This now inflicts 11-22 Damage per second (instead of 10).

//bug fixes
- Settings: Opening the Control Wizard from the Escape Menu wasn't showing it.
- Abilities were using the wrong level to determine their cool-down.
- Abilitary Connoisseur class: There was a chance the Abilitum shop wouldn't be offered if a Stranger event shows.
- Cog Gobbler class: You could be offered the Cogged Healthies and Health Chip passive items.
- Void Devourer weapon: It's projectiles weren't destroying themselves when leaving the view.

notes.title: Patch v1.7
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- Rogue Convergence: On the win screen the Menu Confirm will now take you to the title screen while Menu Back will start a new run.
- Voidworld Trials: On the win/death screen going to the title will now immediately take you to Choose Trials menu.
- Increased the amount of Invincibility frames you get when hit.
- Reduced the amount of contact damage upgraded enemies do.
- The level 3 Bobombous enemy now won't create bullets when it's killed.
- Servo Gunineer drone: Its cost has been increased by +10.

//bug fixes
- Buying an upgrade for a weapon that was the same as was used to buy a mega weapon could cause a crash.
- A class's chosen Hat wasn't being worn if you went to the title screen and didn't open the Skins menu.
- Choosing a class Paint would then use that colour for all classes.
- The run timer stat wasn't increasing during the shopping phase.
- Enemy laser attacks could hit you before they had fully powered up.
- Abilitum Enscripter shop: The Ability Fortuity Shipment item was displaying a cool-down.
- Blacksmithy Forger class: The colour of guns he gives wasn't correct.
- Clashful Card unlock tip: The colour of the icon wasn't correct.
- Broken Chronotron passive item: Its description didn't have the "extra enemies" tip.

notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- The room transition effect has been changed so it's less bright and glitchy.
- The black static effect when entering/exiting the Status Screen and Shops have been reduced.
- Reduced the brightness of enemy lasers, explosions and some Boss attacks.
- Rogue Convergence - The Cog value pickup soft cap has been increased to 333.
- Rogue Convergence - The Cog value pickup soft cap now only counts the amount of Cogs you've picked up that sector (instead of just using your current Cog amount).
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty [5] Boss: If the huge eye begins to attack then the medium eyes will now stop attacking.
- Shop - Encrypted Contact: The cost of their services have been increased by +5.

//bug fixes
- When choosing a Difficulty or Starting Weapon you couldn't choose the Fortuity Destiny option.
- When choosing a Difficulty the Best Score stat was wrong (it was saving the data wrong so you'll need to set a new best score).
- Compendium: If you tried to access the Leaderboards during or just after playing the Tutorial then it would cause a crash.
- Clashful Cards: When using a gamepad if you only had one card left to choose and pressed Up/Down then it would cause a hard freeze.
- When opening the Status Screen there was a rare chance of it causing a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: If you were offered more than 1 mega weapon and had the same weapons then they could still be used for another mega weapon even if they weren't level 3.
- Dronengineer shop: There was a rare chance of a crash when buying an upgrade.
- Auxiliary Droneus passive item: If you have this item the Status Screen would not show the drone icons correctly.
- Jellied Lifeform passive item: This could still give score during a Boss fight.

notes.title: Patch v1.5
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- When you select a Class it will now check to see if you have its unlock achievement and give it if you don't (in case Steam didn't the first time).
- You can now re-enter Shops that have sold out (in case you want to sell/move your items).
- Changed some of the Shop descriptions so it's clearer they allow you to sell/move your items.
- Syphon Traitium passive item: Its Max Health/Energy boost now has a soft cap of 333.

//bug fixes
- Device Repository shop: When using a gamepad pressing Left/Right when the bottom item is selected will cause a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad selling/removing one of your weapons would always take the first weapon.
- Elementalist / Schematic Engraver shop: When using a gamepad you couldn't examine your weapon elements.
- Survival Function game mode: Taking the Auxiliary Abilitum item from a Trove could cause a crash.
- Survival Function game mode: When using a gamepad the Treasure Trove's Remove/Skip were assigned to the same button.
- Survival Function game mode: When using a gamepad if you take a Weapon Trove item then the selected panel sprite is wrong.
- Void Devourer weapon: This was doing very little damage if you had the Blast Traitum.
- BFG 6900 weapon: This was doing less damage if you had the Blast Traitum.
- Loyalty Card item: There would sometimes not be a shop on sale.

notes.title: Patch v1.4
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Settings - Controls - Control Wizard: If you chose the Keyboard Only option then it would unbind the Abillity_1 key.
- Settings - General - Display: The Borderless Window option wasn't triggering when you booted up the game.
- Codex Compendium - Itemography: When using a gamepad the menus weren't working correctly.
- Status Screen: When using a gamepad pressing Up when the gun info was selected could make the selector disappear or cause a crash.
- Survival Function game mode: When using a gamepad the Treasure Trove's Skip/Re-roll were assigned to the same button.
- Shopping - Gun Runner: When using a gamepad pressing Down to move to your weapons could cause a crash.
- Blacksmithy Forger class: The amount of Cogs he was removing if you had maxed either your weapons/abilities/drones wasn't correct.
- Healing Winds ability: It wasn't healing the correct amount.
- Element Core passive item: This was only counting starting element boosts for purposes of working out the highest element.
- Servo Impostus drone: He could keep luring enemies when he should not be able to.
- Element Deposit special room: In an Elementless Temple area hacking an Element Deposit wasn't giving anything (it now chooses a random element to boost).
- You could enter a new sector from the portal and be immediately killed by a very well placed Mineus enemy.

notes.title: Patch v1.3
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Settings - Controls - Control Wizard: If you chose "Keyboard and Mouse" then the mouse cursor would become invisible.
- Voidworld Trials game mode: Entering a trial for the first time could cause a crash.
- Shopping Phase - Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad if you had a lot of guns and moved the selector to your guns then back to the shop items it could cause a crash.
- Straima Ninja class: The score needed to unlock it wasn't correct.
- Crooked Dice passive item: It's Survival Function description wasn't correct.
- Elemental Core passive item: This wasn't boosting Body stats correctly.
- Status Screen: When opened during the shopping phase it would show the Shop background.

notes.title: Patch v1.2
notes.notes:
//bug fixes
- Control Wizard: When using a gamepad the initial menu wasn't confirming correctly.
- Gunineer Drone item: They would cause a crash if they inflicted damage on enemies.
- Shopping: When using a gamepad if you moved the selector to your own items then exited/entered a shop it could cause a crash.
- Shopping: Swapping from using the mouse to using a gamepad could cause a crash when entering a shop.
- Shopping: When using a gamepad the selector would sometimes disappear after buying an item.
- Shopping - Encrypted Contact: When using a gamepad the selector wasn't working correctly.
- Shopping - Encrypted Contact: Choosing an option would give you Cogs instead of spending them.
- Shopping - When paying to re-roll the shops the fee was an extra 5 Cogs more than it what it says.
- Servomegatronica Drone item: Its level pips were showing as level 2.

notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
//misc changes
- Improved performance when there's a lot of enemies on screen.

//bug fixes
- Settings - Controls - Gamepad: Changing a button re-binding would cause a crash.
- Status Screen: When using a gamepad if you exited then entered the screen whilst on the Weapon Info then pressed Up it would cause a crash.
- Droneraiser Minioneer class: Entering the shop with a lot of Drone items could cause a crash.
- Shop: When selling a weapon there was a chance of it causing a crash.
- Rogue Convergence - Boss: Dying in a Difficulty 3+ run could cause a crash.
